title: agent.identity v1
description: Result of the agent.identity capability: who the calling process will be recorded as, how that was determined, and which executions are active. Describes the JSON printed by Praxis `ros provenance identity --json` (kemiller2002/praxis src/Ros.Cli/ProvenanceCommands.fs, commit 58cf46a). The actor is the Praxis actor. Self-reported provenance: it is not authentication, authorization, or evidence (RQ-ROS-2026-A010, spec §5.5). Values Praxis does not know are null here (identity) or the literal "unknown" (actor); consumers MUST NOT substitute guesses. Additional fields added by later minor releases MUST be preserved or ignored, never rejected.

identity.description: The resolved runtime identity behind the actor. null: not known.

mechanism.description: The discovery mechanism that determined the identity, e.g. whitelisted-claude-environment.

assurance.description: Always self-reported: the result is provenance, never authentication.
